- One document authority and filtered current/history selection

- [ ] PORTABLE-DOC-T003 One document authority and filtered current/history selection
  - manifest: `task-manifests/PORTABLE-DOC-T003.yaml`
  - depends on: PORTABLE-DOC-T001
  - files: `scripts/amplai_docs.py`, `scripts/loopctl.py`, `scripts/loopv2.py`, `.ai-team/policy/documentation.json`, `.ai-team/knowledge/doc-impact.schema.json`, `.ai-team/knowledge/context-pack.schema.json`, `tools/amplai-loop-kit/`, `tests/ai/test_document_lifecycle.py`, `specs/012-portable-document-lifecycle/`

Acceptance:
- canonical-stale, valid historical release and unknown lifecycle retain separate dimensions
- age alone cannot discard a valid older-version runbook
- one active canonical per qualified topic/release/security scope; historical releases coexist
- duplicate active canonical within the same qualified scope is rejected before selection
- every current portable search/context/index consumer excludes superseded canaries before title/snippet creation
- folder moves cannot leave stale derived chunks, snippets, indexes or caches selected

Eval:
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ai/test_document_lifecycle.py`
